name: phase-B
cohort: new speaker-disjoint validation only; not independent test
phase_selection: maximize unweighted mean finite band rho below4kHz before noise; narrow restricts to abs<=3; order0,-,+ resolves ties
noise_selection: same phase criterion first; then choose alpha0,.25,.5,.75,1 by highband(>=1600Hz) four-bin log energy after bounded envelope gains; no seed search
trajectory: 3 voiced received f0 in50..500Hz; latest f0 period must match PLC period within20%; slope=(f2-f0)/(2N), delta(t)=0.5*slope/f2*t^2/(1+t/(2N)), clipped+-8; t=PLC elapsed+ahead; no target/gain head
eligibility: same existing history/confidence/fade/nonzero guard; missing f0 returns exact0
report: all variants, not best oracle selection
rho quartiles and offsets per band/language
matched selector with actual variant recovery feedback; not forced identical decoder histories
causal_phase_mlp: separate protocol required before training; no GRU
